reviews.text: What a rude staff member at the front desk , blue haired women with contact lenses , has made my experience very bad here in Bangkok for the 1st time , for the whole day i have been travelling the city , it was time for me to go back to my apartment but i needed something to smoke , walking towards the station i saw this shop , i am with my wife and my son , i know very well that kids are not allowed in any of the weed shops which is understandable , i told my wife and son to wait outside my son listens to me very well and wasn't coming into the shop , my wife comes in and my son is standing at the door of the entrance knowing not to come in , the lady at the front then shouts at my son and says NO NO NO NO NO LIKE HE was a DOG , 2 YEAR old boy , soo that offended me i then proceeded to say to her that my experience in Bangkok has been kind of bad , she said why is that , i said people isn't as friendly here as in Phuket , she then goes to say ahhh here in Thailand we only focus on ourselves not you farangs , i then said wow that's not nice , i said its good to make your guests feel welcome so they come back again i then said in Morocco we look after our guests very very well this is why people come back she then says well you are not in Morocco you are in Thailand baby, and then i mentioned that people in Phuket say hello and smile and make sure my son is okay , she then said well here in Bangkok we don't need to say hello to WESTERNERS i then said who comes in the shop to buy the weed ? is it locals or westerners she said westerners so i said so then it should be a objective to make your customers feel welcomed into the shop , she then said i don't have to do anything but do my job , i said well that's not the right attitude to have don't you care about the business and the bosses customers , she then goes to say i don't care i am only a staff and and i am getting paid regardless , i then said well if you was working for me i would fire you , because this is not how you treat customers and its definitely not how you speak to little 2 year old's , telling them no no no no no loudly like its her child, i am his father and i will tell my son no or yes as he listens to me ... you lost a customer today as i was really about to invest in the shop and buy a load to smoke , but she ruined it and i wont be recommending this shop to anyone ,in fact i will do the opposite of that and tell people not tooo go there , i live in Thailand Phuket and came here for the week to find out how good Bangkok is and honestly she ruined it for me as i am a big smoker and enjoy smoking cannabis , i did not want to write this review , but as she wasn't acting professional i am going to act professional , have a good day and good luck , fyi learn some customer service , coming from a British guy that knows level 10 customer service
